measurement.scope: Declared maximum runtime profiles. Conditional integrations and permissions are treated as enabled; actual requests can be smaller.
measurement.wire_shape: Exact ordered Anthropic custom-tool JSON after global/request last-value deduplication and final ephemeral cache breakpoint.
measurement.prompt_shape: Each profile records the request-scoped tool reference built from its exact ordered tool names and selected capability sets; top-level prompt bytes are the largest measured production profile.
measurement.provider_tools: Provider-native web search is counted separately and is unavailable on the streaming path.
measurement.registration_guard: Registration-source hashes force review when runtime assembly changes; the shared wire projector prevents measurement drift.

nonblocking_targets.note: Directional consolidation target; current exact baselines remain the enforced no-growth ceilings.

runtime.not_declared_to_router_scope: Modern routed Slack Bolt profiles only
